---
title: "Overview of Ecosystem Service: Nature View Amenity"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    standalone: true
---

Urban and coastal nature is valued as the room-price premium hotel guests pay for a natural
view. Within one hotel on one date, a sea-, mountain-, lake- or garden-view room prices above
a comparable room without the view; that difference is a market price for the view itself,
because brand, location, star rating and service difference out inside the hotel. The base
year is 2019.

⚠ Two of the owner's conventions are kept and named rather than changed: the room prices are
scraped at the submission's own booking dates and applied to 2019 room-nights, and one uniform
mean occupancy (from the 106 reporting countries in the UN Tourism table) applies to every
country. Because the scrape is 2026 money, the published figure deflates it to 2019 by the
shared US CPI factor; the owner-vintage reading is kept beside it and is what the replication
anchor holds at.

## Quantity

The country's hotel room-nights carrying a natural view: UN Tourism hotel rooms 2019, times
the uniform mean occupancy, times 365, times the scenic-room share -- the natural-view share of
displayed room availability in the sample, over records with a positive price and availability.

## Price

The unit price difference per room-night: within each of the 7,270 comparable groups (same
hotel, date and room configuration), the mean natural-view price minus the mean comparable
non-view price. Groups outside three Excel-inclusive interquartile ranges of the log price
ratio, or with a negative premium, are dropped (`5,213` kept); the country figure weights each
group's difference by its scenic-room availability.

## Valuation

$$
\text{GEP}_i = R_i \; \bar{o} \; 365 \; s_i \; d_i
$$

with $R_i$ the hotel rooms, $\bar{o}$ the uniform mean occupancy, $s_i$ the scenic-room share
and $d_i$ the unit price difference. A country missing any input carries NA with the absence
named in a note column, never a silent zero. The owner's results workbook is carried beside
the result as the replication anchor, and the run log reports the per-country agreement.

## Inputs

All paths and parameters come from `es_parameters.csv` under the `nature_view_amenity` service
key: the raw room-price sample (read only for the coordinate-to-country mapping), the
analysis-ready comparable-group workbook, the country mapping, the UN Tourism room inventory
and the owner's reference, each with a source row beside it.
